# Genshin Impact Pity, Wish, and Banner Mechanics

## Character Event Banners (Limited Character Banners)
Character event banners feature one limited 5-star character and three featured 4-star characters. 

### 1. 5-Star Drop Rate & Pity
- **Base Probability**: The base chance to roll a 5-star character is **0.6%**.
- **Soft Pity**: Beginning at the **74th wish**, the probability of rolling a 5-star increases by **6%** with each consecutive pull (i.e., 6.6% on 74, 12.6% on 75, etc.) until a 5-star is won.
- **Hard Pity**: Set at the **90th wish**, which is a 100% guaranteed 5-star if none were rolled earlier.
- **The 50/50 Rule**: When you roll a 5-star, there is a **50% chance** it will be the featured limited character, and a **50% chance** it will be a standard 5-star character (e.g. Diluc, Jean, Mona, Keqing, Qiqi, Tighnari, Dehya).
- **Guaranteed Pity**: If you lose the 50/50 and receive a standard 5-star, your *next* 5-star on the character event banner is **100% guaranteed** to be the featured limited character. This guarantee carries over across future character event banners and never expires.

### 2. 4-Star Drop Rate & Pity
- **Base Probability**: The base chance to roll a 4-star is **5.1%**.
- **Hard Pity**: You are guaranteed a 4-star character or weapon by the **10th wish** from your last 4-star roll.
- **Featured Guarantee**: When rolling a 4-star, there is a **50% chance** it is one of the three featured 4-stars. If you roll a non-featured 4-star, the next 4-star is guaranteed to be one of the three featured ones.

---

## Weapon Event Banners (Epitomized Path)
Weapon banners feature two limited 5-star weapons and five featured 4-star weapons.

### 1. 5-Star Drop Rate & Pity
- **Base Probability**: The base chance to roll a 5-star weapon is **0.7%**.
- **Soft Pity**: Begins at the **63rd wish**, where the rates rise quickly towards 100%.
- **Hard Pity**: Set at the **80th wish**.
- **The 75/25 Rule**: When you roll a 5-star, there is a **75% chance** it is one of the two featured promotional weapons, and a **25% chance** it is a standard pool weapon.

### 2. Epitomized Path (Fate Points)
- **Mechanic**: You select one of the two featured 5-star weapons as your goal before pulling.
- **Points**: If you roll a 5-star that is NOT your selected weapon, you receive **1 Fate Point**.
- **Guaranteed Roll**: Once you have **1 Fate Point** (as of Version 5.0, decreased from 2 points in earlier versions), the next 5-star weapon you roll is **100% guaranteed** to be your chosen weapon. Your Fate Point resets to 0 upon obtaining your target weapon. Fate Points do *not* carry over across banner updates.

---

## Standard & Chronicled Wish Banners
- **Standard Banner (Wanderlust Invocation)**: Uses Acquaint Fates. Pity is at 90. Equal chance for standard 5-star characters and standard 5-star weapons.
- **Pity Carryover**: Standard, Character Event, and Weapon Event banners maintain *separate* pity counters.
